_comment: The ideas board. /ideas posts the header, then one message per idea with a thumbs up and thumbs down to vote on. Edit this file and post it again in a fresh channel.
title: One bot for the whole faction
ping_note: {mention} the Trials idea in here is the one aimed at your XO Trial. You are the one person who can say whether having the bot count it for you would have helped, or whether it would just be noise. Say so in here, or react on the idea itself.
intro:
We run twenty-five bots. Ten of them do a job Jarcord already does today.

Below is every idea for replacing the rest, one message each. React 👍 or 👎 on the ones you have an opinion about. Nothing here is decided, and nothing gets uninstalled until its replacement has run beside it for a week.

The full write-up is in the PDF. This channel is so you can argue with the ideas one at a time instead of replying to a document.

ideas.title: Enforcement
ideas.tag: A week · Free · retires Dyno, YAGPDB, Sapphire
ideas.body:
Mute, kick, ban and a case history per member.

The escalation rule reads the warnings we already store, so a fourth warning inside thirty days can time somebody out without an officer doing the arithmetic. Cases land in the log channel that already exists.

ideas.title: Recruitment
ideas.tag: A week · Free · retires Invite Tracker and InviteLogger
ideas.body:
Who invited whom, a leaderboard, and bonus invites an officer can hand out.

One module retires two bots, because we are running both of them for the same job. Optional invite ranks if we want recruiting to be worth something.

ideas.title: Roblox link
ideas.tag: A week · Free · retires Bloxlink and RoWifi
ideas.body:
Proof a member actually owns the account, group rank read into Discord roles, and a nightly sync so ranks do not drift.

Another two bots for one module. It reads ranks, it does not write them back to the group. Writing needs a key from an account inside the group, which is a security risk for something two people would use.

ideas.title: Levels
ideas.tag: A week · Free · retires MEE6 and Arcane
ideas.body:
XP, a rank card and role rewards, reading the activity counter that is already running.

Open question for Command: levels beside ranks means two ladders in one server. Worth deciding whether XP should feed the rank ladder instead.

ideas.title: Applications
ideas.tag: A week · Free · retires Appy and Melonly applications
ideas.body:
An apply form, a review channel, and roles granted the moment somebody is accepted.

Built on the same modal and record-card work that verification and tickets already use, so it is a week rather than a month.

ideas.title: Leave of absence
ideas.tag: A week · Free · retires the Melonly LOA
ideas.body:
Request leave with dates and a reason, officers approve it, and the record knows not to count the absence against anybody.

That last part is the reason to build it here rather than keep a separate bot. No other bot can see the attendance it is supposed to excuse.

ideas.title: Server log
ideas.tag: A week · Free · retires Carl-bot and Sapphire logging
ideas.body: Edits, deletes, joins, leaves and role changes, with one channel per event group and an ignore list for the noisy channels.

ideas.title: Stats
ideas.tag: A week · Plus · retires Statbot
ideas.body:
Most active by messages, by voice or by ops turned up to, over any window.

Also an inactive role applied automatically past a threshold, which is the part that actually saves an officer time.

ideas.title: Ping
ideas.tag: A day · Free · retires Role Mention Cooldown
ideas.body:
Ping a role on a cooldown, so nobody can spam something shaped like an everyone ping.

Set which roles are pingable, by whom, and how often.

ideas.title: Merit
ideas.tag: A day · Free · retires Points
ideas.body:
A points currency that pays out when an op closes, so turning up earns something visible.

Open question for Command: should it pay automatically on close, or only by an officer's hand?

ideas.title: Bump
ideas.tag: A day · Free · retires Fibo
ideas.body:
Reminds somebody to bump on DISBOARD once the cooldown is up, and pings a role if we want it pinged.

Jarcord cannot bump for us. DISBOARD's own rules forbid a bot doing it on a server's behalf, so reminding is the whole feature.

ideas.title: Autoresponder
ideas.tag: A day · Free · retires Mimu autoresponders
ideas.body: Canned replies to the questions that get asked every single week. Set a trigger, set the reply, choose whether it fires server wide or in one channel.

ideas.title: Leaver
ideas.tag: A day · Free · retires Welcomer and Mimu leave messages
ideas.body: A leave message, so departures land in the same channel as arrivals instead of quietly not happening. Extends the welcome setup we already have rather than adding another command to learn.

ideas.title: Panel extras
ideas.tag: A day · Free · retires Embed Generator
ideas.body: Edit a panel in place after it is posted, import one from JSON, and post a one-off embed without writing a panel file for it.

ideas.title: Counters
ideas.tag: A day · Plus · retires ServerStats and Statbot counters
ideas.body:
Live member counts, op counts and anything else we track, written into voice channel names.

Capped at three so we are not renaming channels every minute and eating the rate limit.

ideas.title: Welcome image
ideas.tag: A day · Plus · retires Welcomer Pro
ideas.body: A background image behind the welcome card, so a new member's first message from us looks like it came from a faction rather than a default template.

ideas.title: Ticket extras
ideas.tag: A day · Plus · retires Tickety auto-close
ideas.body: Close a ticket automatically after a set number of hours of silence, and define our own ticket kinds beyond the ones shipped.

ideas.title: Trials
ideas.tag: A day · Free · nothing else does this
ideas.body:
Put somebody on trial for a rank and write down what they have to do to earn it. Three ops hosted, five attended, no warnings inside the window, whatever Command decides the bar is.

The bot already knows every one of those numbers, because hosting, attendance, ratings and warnings are all on the record. So the trial tracks itself and posts in the command channel the moment somebody clears the bar, instead of a trial quietly running for two months because nobody remembered to check on it.

`/trial start @member <rank>` to open one, `/trial` to see who is on a trial and how far along they are, `/trial pass` or `/trial fail` to close it. The result lands on the member's record either way, so a failed trial is not invisible the next time they come up.

We have a live one running right now, and the only way to know where it stands is to go and count by hand. That is the whole argument for this.

ideas.title: The settings channel
ideas.tag: Phase one · Free · nothing else can be built first
ideas.body:
Melonly's selling point is a browser dashboard. It is a second thing to log into, and an officer is already in Discord, so the switches live in Discord too.

`/setup channel` creates a locked channel and posts one panel. Every module is a row with a toggle and a Configure button. Manage Server can toggle anything, officers can toggle officer business, nobody else can see the channel.

No bot gets removed in this phase. Everything after it waits on this, so it goes first regardless.

ideas.title: What we are deliberately not building
ideas.tag: For the record · say so if you disagree
ideas.body:
**Music.** Google shut Groovy and Rythm down in 2021. Any source is a takedown waiting to happen.

**TikTok feeds.** No public API. A self-built poller is scraping, and it breaks whenever the page changes.

**Economy games.** Merit covers what a faction needs. Dank Memer stays where it is.

**Writing Roblox ranks.** Needs a key from an account inside the group. Support burden and security risk for no revenue.

**Moderation filters.** Discord AutoMod already does this, free, and does it better.

ideas.title: Six things Command has to answer
ideas.tag: None of these block phase one · all of them change the order after it
ideas.body:
1. Do we keep a Roblox group whose ranks should drive Discord roles, or are ranks Discord only?
2. Should Merit pay out automatically when an op closes, or only by an officer's hand?
3. Levels beside ranks means two ladders. Do we want that, or should XP feed the rank ladder?
4. Is the settings channel a new channel, or a pinned panel in the existing Command category?
5. Which modules should be on the moment a new server adds Jarcord, and which start off?
6. Voice TTS needs extra dependencies on the host for something one or two people use. Build it, or leave TTS Bot installed?
